description: Trigger this skill when an API contract requires data fields that do not exist in the current database schema. Use for: 1. Designing new table structures or columns (ALTER/CREATE). 2. Creating Data Migration plans. 3. Ensuring database naming conventions align with enterprise standards. DO NOT use for: Designing API contracts or analyzing UI. REQUIRES: ./discovery/schema_map.md and ./contracts/mapping/ lineage files.

tools.name: schema_gap_analyzer
tools.description: Python script to compare the required fields in the Contract Lineage against the Database Schema Map to identify missing columns.

tools.name: sql_standards
tools.description: Enterprise standards for SQL dialect (Default: PostgreSQL), naming conventions, and migration safety rules.

runtime_directives.description: Prefer creating logical VIEWS or Materialized Views if the data exists in disparate tables. Only propose ALTER TABLE if new storage is required.
